name: _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization
statement: R) [IsLocalization.Away f S] : IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R S)))

name: exists_affine_mem_range_and_range_subset
statement: Scheme.{u}} {x : X} {U : X.Opens} (hxU : x ∈ U) : ∃ R, ∃ (f : Spec R ⟶ X), IsOpenImmersion f ∧ x ∈ Set.range f ∧ Set.range f ⊆ U

name: image_basicOpen
statement: X.Opens} (r : Γ(X, U)) : f ''ᵁ X.basicOpen r = Y.basicOpen ((f.appIso U).inv r)
